verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Svelte ships an interactive tutorial with live sandboxes as an onramp, and svelte.dev exposes an llms.txt for AI consumption, but the pack never shows a dedicated interactive API reference with runnable examples (distinct from the tutorial), and no OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec exists per the probe. missing for 10: explicit API reference (not just tutorial) with embedded runnable examples, and independent confirmation this reference is AI/agent-navigable.
